items.title: CANCER · THE NURTURER

items.title: LIBRA · THE DIPLOMAT

items.title: SCORPIO · THE ALCHEMIST

items.title: SAGITTARIUS · THE SEEKER

items.title: CAPRICORN · THE ELDER

items.title: AQUARIUS · THE VISIONARY
